images.author: Datingscout
images.why: Photographer identifies a large wild elephant walking in Botswana’s Okavango Delta; green grassland setting. Sex, native dimensions and 9:10 crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Florian Kriechbaumer
images.why: Classic savanna elephant composition with Kilimanjaro behind; documented camera photograph, 2699 × 1852. Sex unconfirmed; landscape composition needs careful portrait cropping.

images.author: Advik Mehta
images.why: Explicitly identified male tusker crossing open grassland in Amboseli, Kenya. One tusk is broken; native dimensions and crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Anita Ramesh
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies a tusker in Bandipur, India, walking through grassy woodland; Leica Q2 photograph. Native dimensions and 9:10 crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Ojas Raj
images.why: Wild Indian elephant in Bandipur, described as facing the camera while eating grass, with a visible tusk and golden-hour setting. Native dimensions and full-body crop unverified.

images.author: Sander’s Photography
images.why: Photographer documents a rare male Asian big tusker with crossed tusks in India; image description identifies Kabini. Distinctive tusker alternative; resolution, full-body framing and reuse permission require confirmation.

images.author: Rafael Peier
images.why: Source identifies a white rhinoceros walking across open Namibian terrain; Canon EOS M5 photograph featured in Nature. Sex, native dimensions and diagnostic anatomy not independently visually verified.

images.author: Rafael Peier
images.why: Alternative standing composition identified as a wild white rhinoceros in Namibia’s dry grassland. Sex, native dimensions and diagnostic anatomy not independently visually verified.

images.author: Sam Power
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies two white rhinos at sunrise in Nairobi National Park; strong lighting alternative. Two animals rather than one; native dimensions and portrait crop unverified.

images.author: Omkar Rane
images.why: Wild one-horned rhinoceros photographed walking along a track in Kaziranga, India; potentially clearer body separation than tall-grass scenes. Native dimensions and crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Dipinder Rainu
images.why: Source identifies a solitary one-horned rhino standing in Kaziranga’s green grassland, matching the requested species and wild habitat. Native dimensions and leg visibility unverified.

images.author: Nitesh Mehera
images.why: Indian rhinos grazing in Kaziranga; 3990 × 5997 portrait original offers substantial cropping latitude. Misty light and multiple animals make this a habitat-focused alternative.

images.author: Matthew Luizza/USFWS
images.why: Authoritative identification of wild African forest elephants at Dzanga Bai; downloadable 4608 × 3456 original. Group scene rather than an isolated bull; individual-animal 9:10 crop unverified.

images.author: Daphne Carlson Bremer/USFWS
images.why: Explicitly identified forest elephants in a rainforest clearing at Dzanga Bai; 4592 × 3448 original. Reliable species and habitat match, but a herd composition rather than a confirmed solitary adult male.
